title: Concept: Service unit list exposed in a response
description: A systemd unit listing with service names and states in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The listing names every service on the host, which shows the attacker which daemons share the machine with the application and which ones look stale.
applicability: Deployments that render a systemd unit listing with service names and states into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The listing names every service on the host, which shows the attacker which daemons share the machine with the application and which ones look stale.
